properties.name: Rapa Nui (Easter Island) — Moai
properties.description: 887 monolithic moai statues carved by the Rapa Nui people. The statues represent deified ancestors, their backs to the sea, watching over the living.

properties.name: Kīlauea — Home of Pele
properties.description: World's most active volcano and home of the goddess Pele. Halemaʻumaʻu crater is her sacred fire pit. Lava flows are her divine body.
properties.modernStatus: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park, UNESCO World Heritage Site
